skill_name: Describe a creative way to use wearables as part of a marketing campaign.
workflow: A creative use of wearables for marketing could involve using the device to facilitate customer engagement. For example, businesses could create audio promotions and give out the devices to customers with instructions to listen to the audio promotion when they wear the devices. These audio promotions could include deals and discounts, surveys, or even audio ads.
